canada-dnd-gagetown.n: 5 CDSB Gagetown / Gagetown Range and Training Area
canada-dnd-gagetown.cp: NRCan Canadian Geographical Names Database (CGNDB) official feature DBDXI (Gagetown Range and Training Area, MIL). Official named-feature point; not a surveyed installation or range footprint. (place_name_approx)
canada-dnd-gagetown.st: Active Canadian Army support base and range/training area. The official base page says 5 CDSB Gagetown opened in 1958 as a training facility and has an 1,100 square km training area. The main garrison is in Oromocto. As of the IAAC 90236 page checked on 2026-11-23, Fleet Diving Unit Atlantic still sends live ordnance and white phosphorus munitions to Gagetown for disposal. No open IAAC public-comment period for Gagetown was found on that date.
canada-dnd-gagetown.what: Coordinates are the official NRCan CGNDB military feature 'Gagetown Range and Training Area' (geoname DBDXI), not a surveyed range footprint. A separately named official CGNDB feature 'Canadian Forces Base Gagetown' (DAABL) is at 45.833333, -66.45, nearer the Oromocto garrison described on the base page. Five former waste-disposal sites at the base are described on the Agent Orange investigations page (Shirley Road main dump, drum disposal area, asbestos dump area, chemical container disposal area, and ash disposal site); the chemical container disposal area was excavated and remediated in 1984. Those are contamination/disposal sites, not a current munitions inventory. A 2006 DND-wide herbicide review cited on that page concluded Agent Orange and other unregistered U.S. herbicides were only used at Base Gagetown among the CAF sites reviewed.
